method: Questions were researched with an evidence-only retrieval tool over one corpus of open-access and public-domain texts (see corpus.json). Each excerpt was checked word for word against the corpus passage it cites when this file was written; corpus_chunk numbers that passage in the corpus snapshot of 2026-10-01.
questions: How did Mill and Whewell disagree about induction?
What did Peirce's fallibilism amount to, and how did it differ from skepticism?
What are the phases of Dewey's pattern of inquiry?
How is Mill's argument for freedom of speech structured?
What did James mean by calling truth a species of the good?
What is Comte's law of the three stages?
